title: Package 123 Increment-86 Checkpoint Completeness and Continuation Audit

gauss_point_history_variables_H.finding: The converged history array trial_driving_energy was held only in Python process memory during Job 1417938. It was not serialized to disk, leaving d_lower_bounds.csv at its pre-solve mapped initial state.

damage_lower_bounds_irreversibility.finding: d_lower_bounds.csv on disk retains the initial donor mapped bounds, not the cycle 12 converged bounds d_cyc12.

active_set_multipliers_lambda.finding: Dual multipliers lambda were evaluated in Python memory but only summary min_lambda was recorded in JSON.

abaqus_restart_database.finding: M1_C4_INC86_HOLDOUT.inp ran as 12 uncoupled single-step static mechanical jobs without *RESTART, WRITE directives. No binary restart file (.res/.mdl) exists for Cycle 12.

continuation_eligibility_verdict.prohibition_reason: Policy strictly prohibits fabricating missing integration-point history or silently resetting internal variables from ODB fields alone. Without persisted 17,688 Gauss-point history variables H_k and committed lower bounds, a genuine continuation cannot be initialized without state corruption.
